correctness.rationale: The central-edge criterion for reverse-complement palindromes is an equivalence, the extension table is proved for all parity cases using the equality-edge strings, and the length-seven base is exhaustively checkable. Induction establishes all every length at least seven and the finite prefix-state graph establishes the one-sided infinite corollary. Direct and edge-coded algorithms agree on all 65,408 words lengths seven through fifteen; candidate extension predictions hold for lengths seven through eighty-nine. These are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
